content:
maria_finance: Incoming EUR bank transfer from customer NimbusHealth for €42,750 arrived yesterday but remittance field only contains a truncated reference: "Ref: INV312...". We can't match to PO#98765 or any invoice. customer requires PO on the payment to apply credit. Can someone help trace full reference or confirm which invoice to settle?

oliver_payments: I see the SWIFT MT103 from our PSP. The beneficiary remittance has been truncated on their bank's side. Bank ref = 2024-05-07/CHQ/INV312... (truncated). Transaction ID: TXN-9F4B2C. Posting date 2024-05-07.

sam_support: Quick check — did the webhook from payment-gateway contain any metadata? I can re-run a search by amount + date if needed. Also check internal reconciliation table: 
```sql
SELECT * FROM bank_transfers WHERE amount = 42750 AND currency = 'EUR' AND posted_at BETWEEN '2024-05-07' AND '2024-05-08';
```
This usually surfaces the customer_id or external_reference if present.

maria_finance: Ran that query, result shows a row with external_reference = null. Only trace: TXN-9F4B2C and payer name = NimbusHealth GmbH. No invoice_id.

oliver_payments: I'll file a trace with the acquiring bank. Banks usually respond with full remittance text via MT103 copy or a bank-trace. I'll include the MT103 snippet and ask them to provide the un-truncated 'remittance info' field.

accounting-bot: Created ticket ACC-2026: bank-trace-request for NimbusHealth payment (TXN-9F4B2C). Assignee: oliver_payments. Priority: high.

maria_finance: Thanks. Customer is blocked because finance can't apply the payment without PO match — sales needs the credit applied by EOD. Tanya, fyi.

tanya_sales: Got it. Nimbus notes this payment is for invoice INV-312 and PO#98765 but our system needs the remittance/PON to auto-apply. I'll ping their AP team. Can you please include the customer contact in the trace request?

oliver_payments: Will do. Drafting email to bank now. Sample request I'm sending: 

```
Subject: Trace request for TXN-9F4B2C / MT103 copy required

Hello,

Please provide a full copy of the MT103 or original remittance details for transaction TXN-9F4B2C posted 07-May-2024 for EUR 42,750 to account DE12 3456 7890 1234 5678. Our current copy shows remittance truncated to "INV312..." which prevents invoice matching. We need the full remittance field and any additional bank-level reference (end-to-end id) to apply payment to PO#98765.

Reference: TXN-9F4B2C
Customer: NimbusHealth GmbH
Amount: EUR 42,750
Posting date: 07-May-2024

Thanks,
Oliver - Payments
```

sam_support: Once bank returns MT103, I can run a quick text-match job across unpaid_invoices to find the exact invoice. Also recommend checking PSP payout CSV: some PSPs put invoice_id in a separate metadata column. Command to fetch last payout: 
```bash
./tools/fetch_payouts.sh --psp stripe-eu --since 2024-05-06 > /tmp/payouts.csv
grep '42750' /tmp/payouts.csv -n || true
```

maria_finance: Appreciate it. Action items: oliver -> bank trace + include customer AP contact; sam -> re-run match once MT103 or payout CSV available; tanya -> confirm customer claim of PO#98765 and email AP copy. I'll hold ledger posting until we confirm. :thumbsup:

accounting-bot: Ticket ACC-2026 updated: bank_trace_requested. ETA bank response: 48-72 hours.

maria_finance: Noted. If bank can't retrieve full remittance, we'll ask Nimbus to submit payment proof (bank statement + proof of payment) with full reference so we can apply manually.
